Product Details: The Massimo Lithium ESSM 1475 is a cutting-edge Energy Storage System that combines an integrated lithium-ion battery with a pure sine wave inverter in one compact, wall-mountable unit. Designed for modern homes and offices, this plug-and-play solution requires zero maintenance — no water topping, no acid fumes, and no hassle. The advanced Smart BMS (Battery Management System) ensures optimal safety and extends the battery life up to 10–12 years, far outlasting traditional lead-acid batteries. With fast charging technology that charges up to 2X quicker than conventional inverters and an ultra-fast switchover time of just 3ms, your appliances stay powered without interruption. The pure sine wave output makes it perfectly safe for sensitive electronics such as TVs, laptops, and WiFi routers. Its sleek black design and wall-mountable form factor save valuable floor space. Backed by a 5-year warranty, the ESSM 1475 is a reliable, long-lasting power backup solution built for the future.
